title: Figures 11-12: Magnetized Target Fusion Reactor and MHD Fusion Rocket Aerospace Plane
description: Figure 11, 'Magnetized Target Fusion Reactor', is a color schematic of a horizontal reactor with a magnetic expansion chamber, a blue burn chamber (Dch ~ 5 cm), and fuel beam injection, with dimensions of 5 m, ~10 m and 1 m. Figure 12, 'MHD Air-Breathing and Fusion Rocket Aerospace Plane', is a color illustration of a delta-winged hypersonic vehicle with callouts for aneutronic fusion power and rocket propulsion from Mach 14 to orbit, air-breathing propulsion and MHD power from Mach 7 to 14, chemical rocket and air-breathing propulsion from 0 to Mach 7, liquid hydrogen/oxygen propellants and a '2025 time period'.
